D: A mild radio exec tries to win over his stepkids when their cool, motorbike-riding real dad comes home.
P: Serve the mains when Brad and Dusty go head to head.
S: Fresh rolls of rice vermicelli, carrot, capsicum and cucumber

Rice paper rolls packed with carrot, capsicum, cucumber, avocado, vermicelli and mint, with a peanut and hoisin dipping sauce. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool. Cut 1 carrot, 1 red capsicum and 1 cucumber into thin strips and slice 1 avocado. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat and add the vegetables, noodles and mint, then roll up tightly. Make 12. Whisk 3 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp lime juice and 3 tbsp warm water for dipping.
Corn chips under spiced beef and melted cheese
Loaded corn chips with beef, cheese, salsa and sour cream, the cool dad's party move.
M: Smashed beef patties, cheese, onion and pickles on potato buns

Double smashed beef patties with melted cheese, caramelised onion, pickles and a tangy burger sauce in toasted potato buns. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. On a very hot barbecue plate, smash each flat, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 potato buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties each with onion and pickles.
W: Vanilla cupcakes filled with jam, pink buttercream and sprinkles

Fluffy vanilla cupcakes with a raspberry jam centre, piped high with pink buttercream and finished with sprinkles and a tiny bow. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Divide between 12 paper cases and bake 18 minutes. Cool. Cut a small cone from the top of each, fill with raspberry jam (120g total) and replace. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and pink colouring and pipe on top. Finish with sprinkles.
K: Strawberry basil syrup, fresh lemon juice and soda water over ice

Fresh lemon juice shaken with strawberry and basil syrup, topped with chilled soda over ice, with sliced strawberries and a basil leaf. Simmer 100g caster sugar, 100ml water and 150g sliced strawberries for 5 minutes. Take off the heat, add a handful of basil and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Squeeze 5 lemons for about 200ml juice. Fill a jug with ice, add the syrup, lemon juice and 800ml cold soda water and stir. Pour into glasses with sliced strawberries and a basil leaf.
